verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can write their own providers ("write your own", linking to /terraform/plugin, and "Create a provider to allow Terraform to interact with a service"). That implies an official developer path for building against Terraform, but no SDK is named or described. missing for 10: an explicitly named official SDK or client libraries (e.g., language SDKs or an API client), documentation of the SDK's scope and languages, programmatic API/OpenAPI coverage (probe found none), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
